test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 11 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Your health could suffer if you spend more time __with the automobiles.__
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence *"Your health could suffer if you spend more time with the automobiles."* uses a phrase in a context where a substitute would be more appropriate.
 
• The phrase "in front of electronic devices" (Option 1) makes the sentence read, "Your health could suffer if you spend more time in front of electronic devices" which implies the negative impact of prolonged screen time, a commonplace idea.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is- *'In front of electronic devices'.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'In backlog of machines' **(Option 2) and** 'besides the machines'** (Option 3) are grammatically incorrect and contextually unclear.
 
• **'After the digital devices' **(Option 4) doesn't convey the intended sentiment of excessive usage causing health issues.
